sources.name: RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database
sources.role: primary (assessment SSB/TB, B/BMSY, U/UMSY, recruitment, catch)
sources.version_target: latest Zenodo release (v4.66 'Extended' seen in search results; exact version to be frozen)
sources.human_action: download release, record DOI, version, checksum; confirm licence text

sources.name: FishGlob_data
sources.raw_redistribution: yes with attribution; citation policy in linked disclaimer (not readable from sandbox)
sources.human_action: read the FishGlob disclaimer/citation policy (Google Docs link) and survey-specific metadata; decide on GMEX inclusion after audit
sources.caveats: survey method changes documented in metadata_docs/README.md (FR-CGFS 2015, GSL-S 1985/1992, SCS 1996, NOR-BTS replaced 2004); DATRAS weights re-estimated from length data

sources.name: ICES DATRAS / Stock Assessment Graphs
sources.role: overlap source (DATRAS surveys already in FishGlob; SAG assessments already in RAM)
sources.license: ICES data policy 2023 (CC BY 4.0 expected; unverified)
sources.human_action: only needed for surveys/stocks not in FishGlob/RAM; otherwise treat as duplicates in the crosswalk

sources.name: Global Population Dynamics Database (GPDD)
sources.version_target: v2010 (KNB doi:10.5063/F1BZ63Z8); rgpdd bundle used in Stage 0
sources.license: rgpdd package CC0 (verified); KNB data terms unverified
sources.raw_redistribution: unverified (685 MainIDs flagged Restricted in the bundle carry no data)
sources.human_action: verify KNB licence and the meaning of the Reliability code (1-5, -1) in the GPDD user guide
sources.caveats: 3615 annual series but only 38 pass provisional screening; effort unknown for harvest series

sources.name: Living Planet Database (public release)
sources.license: data-use agreement on registration (terms unverified; non-commercial and no-redistribution clauses expected)
sources.human_action: register, accept terms, record the release date and population count; check whether derived labels/partitions may be published (checkpoint 1)

sources.name: BioTIME 2.0
sources.role: primary candidate (species x site assemblage abundances)
sources.human_action: download, check per-study restrictions, extract constant-effort species x site annual series

sources.name: Lake challenge set (O'Brien et al. 2023)
sources.license: no LICENSE file; original sources EIDC/EDI/PLOS; Kinneret and Kasumigaura on request only
sources.human_action: request Kinneret/Kasumigaura data if the challenge analysis is pursued; confirm redistribution terms for the public lakes

sources.name: Bury et al. 2021 pretrained classifiers
sources.caveats: inputs are 500/1500-point detrended residual windows; annual ecological series are far shorter; input-compatibility audit required before use
sources.human_action: confirm that CC BY-NC-SA use is compatible with the intended benchmark release

sources.name: ewstools (PyPI)
sources.caveats: package contains no bundled classifier files

sources.name: Fisheries reference points and SST drivers
sources.download: RAM Legacy (B/BMSY, U/UMSY); SST products (HadISST/ERSST/OISST) via NOAA/Met Office
